# Read-only pairing negative control

This is the exact intermediate source captured during the current entry audit, after the first pause/generic mouse-only correction and before the common physical-pair ledger. It is not a released pre.5 implementation and must not be described as one.

`native_message_policy.h` SHA-256: `959b707cedaca064e1b3c44030b152da14d697035093e1e0007d22bd07bf8569`.

The controlled native_readonly_pairing.py driver executes this source through the real formation handler and its real reset. This input version loses ownership of a previously suppressed formation DOWN when read-only retirement resets the formation state, so the matching UP is forwarded. The negative control requires successful compilation and actual assertion failures. Win32 delivery, native game memory and game execution remain outside the fixture.
